items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: I knew him. But he's been always nice to me. Anytime I call him... he says, Okay, Teddy, come on down here

ctx.x: Yeah. Jules Bihari (PHONETIC). The Bahari brothers.
Oh, yeah, I've heard of them. I don't know if they're still -- in Glendale someplace?
